blurb: Heartwood Farm & Cidery raises heritage cattle on pasture with no grain, corn, or soy, practicing managed grazing for natural land regeneration. They produce natural sparkling beverages made from Ontario-grown fruit with no added sugars or preservatives, and craft ciders with unique flavors including maple syrup, cayenne peppers, and dry-hopped blends.
